flashcard_questions.q: In which year was the Globe Theatre built?
Which acting company did Elizabeth pay to set up in 1583?
How many musicians entertained Elizabeth’s court?
Which voyage of 1577–1580 showed English naval reach?
Which Derbyshire house is a famous example of the Great Rebuilding?
How much did prices rise during the sixteenth century?
What happened to wages while prices rose 400%?
How many Catholics were executed during Elizabeth’s reign?
How long was England at war with Spain?
Which costly war in Ireland drained England’s resources?
flashcard_questions.a: The Nine Years’ War, from 1594 to 1603.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Englishman was among the first to trade in enslaved people?
How many printing presses were there in England?
Which body had to approve every book and pamphlet before publication?
Which play did the Earl of Essex use to signal his 1601 uprising?
Why is the “Golden Age” label partly a later invention?
flashcard_questions.a: People looked back with nostalgia during the less popular Stuart reigns.

notes: 15 cards: 7 figure (400%, 200 Catholics, 60 presses, 30 musicians, 37-play count excluded), 4 place/company, 2 event/date, 2 cause-effect. Balanced evidence for and against; avoided the 'how far do you agree' judgement, which belongs in practice questions.
